method: lighthouse CLI against astro preview (local Node server, http://localhost:4321) — NOT wrangler pages dev (fails to start in this sandbox) and NOT the live Cloudflare Workers preview (Chrome headless hits a proxy-TLS interstitial in this sandbox that ignore-certificate-errors did not suppress)
caveat: astro preview is a plain Node static server, not the Cloudflare Workers runtime — results are directionally real but not a perfect production match. Lighthouse performance scores in this sandbox show real run-to-run variance (observed /menu range across 6 runs pre-fix and post-fix: 0.81-0.94) — single-run numbers below are one representative run each, not a guaranteed reproduction.

menu.note: Improved from the prior 0.64/8960ms after fixing /menu's image payload (see benchmarks/deltas/menu-image-optimization.json), but still below the 0.90/2500ms budget. Root cause of the remainder is now identified as DOM size (1526 elements vs ~127 on other routes), not images — see benchmarks/reports/MENU-IMAGE-FIX.okf.md.
